content: व्याघातः .²1 Striking against. .²2 A blow, stroke. .²3 An impediment, obstacle. .²4 Contradiction. .²5 Disobedience; प्रथमं तावन्ममाज्ञाव्याघातः <ls>Mu. 3</ls>. .²6 A figure of speech in which opposite effects are shown to be produced from the same cause or by the same agency; it is thus defined by Mammaṭa: -तद्यथा साधितं केनाप्यपरेण तदन्यथा . तथैव यद्विधीयेत स व्याघात इति स्मृतः .. <ls>K. P. 10</ls>; {%<ab>e. g.</ab>%} see <ls>Vb. 1. 2</ls>, or the quotation under विरूपाक्ष. .²7 Decline, defeat; कामः स्त्रीरनुशयवानिव स्वपक्षव्याघातादिति <ls>Śi. 8. 61</ls>.
